title: Resort Credit Terms Published Against Granite Ridge Season Pass Tiers
content:
Resort credit issued against a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme record carries two published figures per tier: the number of calendar days from issue within which the credit may be applied, and the smallest amount of credit that may be applied to a single charge.

| Tier | Validity period (calendar days from issue) | Smallest single application (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 180 | 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 180 | 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 270 | 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 270 | 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 365 | 50.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 365 | 50.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 730 | 50.00 |

The validity period runs in calendar days from the day the credit was issued, not from the day the pass was bought or the day the season closes; on the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass it runs to 730 calendar days, twice the figure carried by the two tiers above 365.

The smallest single application takes one of two figures across the programme: 25.00 on the four lower tiers and 50.00 on the Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass and the two collective tiers.
